prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1012; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting neck pain, stiffness, and headache beginning shortly after the event. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the forces involved in this type of crash commonly produce this kind of cervical strain. Over three visits, the patient received conservative management including manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for an injury of this kind, reflecting a slower-than-expected rate of improvement. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm soft-tissue injury to the neck. No prior injury or complaint involving the same body region is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. Patient is currently improving and will be reassessed as needed.
